q: Wearing a pale-yellow dokhona — the traditional wraparound dress of Bodo women — and a white blouse, Romel's wife Tillottama, 56, organized chairs for us in her courtyard.
2006, Wasbir Hussain, Homemakers Without the Men:
He first saw Jutimala at the fair. Although she wore a dokhona, she didn't really look like a Bodo he thought.
